title: Workflow Duration Exceeds SLO (p95)

definition.name: [n8n] Workflow Average Execution Duration Above SLO

options.escalation_message: Workflow average duration is still above SLO. Investigate slow nodes, queue backlog, or Node.js runtime saturation.

description: Alerts when a workflow's avg execution duration over 15m exceeds the SLO threshold. Uses n8n 2.x's execution duration histogram (sum/count). True p95 is unavailable (Prometheus histogram, not DD distribution); avg is the best proxy. Grouped by workflow and host.
